t: In front of you is Homage to Leonardo, a bronze statue in Belgrave Square, often called Vitruvian Man because it takes its form from Leonardo da Vinci's famous drawing. Leonardo was the Renaissance painter, engineer, scientist and architect whose notebooks ranged across anatomy, astronomy and botany. The sculptor was Enzo Plazzotta, an Italian-born British artist. He died in 1981, before the work was finished, so his assistant Mark Holloway completed it in 1982. The statue was installed here in 1984.
